title: Protocol to Dissect and Dissociate the Mouse Brainstem for Single-Cell RNA-seq Applications
author: Phillips, Ramadan, et al.

steps.title: Make 10× Pronase Stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g dehydrated pronase in sterile deionized water to a final volume of 50 mL (20 mg/mL) in a 50 mL conical tube by gently rocking to avoid foaming; aliquot 1.5–2 mL into 1.5 or 2.0 mL microtubes, store at –20 °C (max 1 month). Keep thawed aliquots on ice or at 4 °C and use within 2 h; do not refreeze excess.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve pronase gently to 20 mg/mL in 50 mL water.
Aliquot 1.5–2 mL into microtubes.
Store at –20 °C, use within 2 h after thaw, discard if refrozen.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclear Stain Stocks
steps.instruction: Create a 1000× Live‑or‑Dye NucFix Red stock in DMSO per manufacturer, store protected from light at –20 °C and limit freeze‑thaw cycles; prepare Hoechst 33342 5 mg/mL stock in DMSO (vortex/sonicate and warm up to 50 °C if needed), aliquot 0.05–0.5 mL, store protected from light at –20 °C (usable 1–3 months). Hoechst 34580 can be used as an alternative. Note that NucFix Red binds covalently to DNA and should not be substituted.

substeps.instruction: Make 1000× NucFix Red in DMSO, store –20 °C, protect from light.
Make Hoechst 33342 5 mg/mL in DMSO, vortex/sonicate, warm if needed, aliquot, store –20 °C, protect from light.

steps.title: Prepare Dissection ACSF
steps.instruction: Dissolve all dissection ACSF reagents except CaCl₂ and MgSO₄ in ≤990 mL purified water, bubble with 95 % O₂ / 5 % CO₂ for ≥15 min, slowly add CaCl₂ and MgSO₄ while stirring, top up to 1000 mL with deionized H₂O, filter through a 0.22 µm bottle‑top filter into a sterile 1 L glass bottle, seal, label and store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve reagents (no divalent salts) in ≤990 mL water.
Equilibrate with 95 % O₂/5 % CO₂ for ≥15 min.
Add CaCl₂ and MgSO₄ slowly while stirring.
Top up to 1000 mL with deionized water.
Filter (0.22 µm) into sterile glass bottle and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Base Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve the reagents listed in Table 2 (KCl 2.5 mM, NaH₂PO₄ 1.25 mM, NaHCO₃ 30 mM, D‑Glucose 25 mM, Sodium Ascorbate 5 mM, N‑acetyl‑L‑cysteine 12 mM, Ethyl Pyruvate 3 mM, myo‑Inositol 5 mM) in 170 mL deionized water, bubble with 95 % O₂/5 % CO₂ for ≥10 min, continuously stir and slowly add CaCl₂ 0.5 mM and MgSO₄ 10 mM, top up to 180 mL, then split equally into two 90 mL portions in separate 100 mL graduated cylinders for downstream ACSF preparations.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve Table 2 reagents in 170 mL water.
Equilibrate with 95 % O₂/5 % CO₂ for ≥10 min.
Add CaCl₂ (0.5 mM) and MgSO₄ (10 mM) while stirring.
Top up to 180 mL total volume.
Divide into two 90 mL aliquots.

steps.title: Make Dissociation ACSF
steps.instruction: Add the Table 3 reagents (HEPES 20 mM, phenol red 0.001 % from 0.5 % stock, trehalose dihydrate 132 mM (5 g solid)) to 90 mL of the Base Solution, mix, top up to 100 mL with purified water, filter through a 0.22 µm bottle‑top filter into a sterile 100–250 mL bottle, and store at 4 °C for no more than 1 week.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve Table 3 reagents in 90 mL Base Solution.
Top up to 100 mL with purified water.
Filter (0.22 µm) into sterile bottle.
Store at 4 °C (≤1 week).

steps.title: Make Cold Storage ACSF
steps.instruction: Add the Table 4 reagents (HEPES 20 mM, trehalose dihydrate 132 mM (5 g solid)) to 90 mL of the Base Solution, mix, bring volume to 100 mL with purified water, filter through a 0.22 µm bottle‑top filter into a sterile 100–250 mL bottle, and store at 4 °C for no more than 1 week.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve Table 4 reagents in 90 mL Base Solution.
Top up to 100 mL with purified water.
Filter (0.22 µm) into sterile bottle.
Store at 4 °C (≤1 week).

steps.title: Prepare 1% BSA Stock
steps.instruction: Rehydrate 1 g lyophilized BSA in PBS to a final volume of 100 mL (1 % w/v), mix until fully dissolved, and store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare Resuspension Buffer
steps.instruction: In a sterile 15 mL tube add 0.75 mL 20× SSC, then 200 µL of the 1 % BSA stock, 50 µL DTT (100 mM stock), and 25 µL recombinant RNase inhibitor (40 U/µL); top up to 5 mL with RNase‑ and DNase‑free water, store on ice or at 4 °C and use within 3 h for rehydrating methanol‑fixed samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.75 mL 20× SSC.
Add 200 µL 1 % BSA stock.
Add 50 µL DTT (100 mM).
Add 25 µL RNase inhibitor (40 U/µL).
Bring volume to 5 mL with RNase/DNase‑free water.

steps.title: Slice Brainstem and Isolate preBötC
steps.instruction: Fill the vibrating microtome bath with freshly gas‑equilibrated dissection ACSF; position the agar block so its angled surface is perpendicular to the blade; advance the blade and stop before contacting tissue, then manually set the blade ~1 mm in front of the dorsal border and 1 mm below the rostral border. Cut a single slice at 100–200 µm/s, then continue serial sections at 100–150 µm/s, 400 µm thick until the 4th ventricle appears. Take one additional 400 µm section at 60–80 µm/s, then trim a slice at 10–50 µm/s to 150–250 µm thickness (adjust based on landmarks such as nucleus ambiguus). Verify the inferior olive is visible and aim for an “m‑300 µm” slice with the preBötC centered. Cut a final 300 µm slice at 10–50 µm/s without retracting the blade (the blade serves as a stable surface). Using a fine microknife, gently separate the slice from the filter paper while the blade remains in place. Add 1 mL dissection ACSF to a clean 35 mm Sylgard‑lined Petri dish, transfer the slice with a large‑bore glass dropper into the dish, immerse it, and under 10–20× magnification punch out the preBötC from the ventral border of each side with a tissue punch.

substeps.instruction: Fill microtome bath with gas‑equilibrated dissection ACSF.
Position agar block perpendicular to blade.
Set blade ~1 mm in front of dorsal border and 1 mm below rostral border.
Cut first slice at 100–200 µm/s.
Cut serial 400 µm sections at 100–150 µm/s until 4th ventricle visible.
Cut one extra 400 µm section at 60–80 µm/s.
Trim slice at 10–50 µm/s to 150–250 µm thickness (adjust as needed).
Verify inferior olive; aim for m‑300 µm slice.
Cut final 300 µm slice at 10–50 µm/s without retracting blade.
Separate slice from filter paper with microknife while blade stays.
Add 1 mL dissection ACSF to Sylgard‑lined 35 mm dish.
Transfer slice with large‑bore dropper, immerse in ACSF.
Punch out preBötC under 10–20× magnification.

steps.title: Flow Cytometry Cell Sorting
steps.instruction: Calibrate the flow sorter so that single‑cell dispensing into 384‑well plates finishes within 30 min after cell filtration (Step 71). Pre‑dispense the appropriate lysis buffer into each well (SmartSeq3 protocol). Set the instrument to single‑cell dispense mode with a 100 µm nozzle (disposable microfluidic chip), keep both the sample tube holder and the 384‑well plate chilled at 4 °C, and operate only by trained personnel. Sort rehydrated cells within 30 min to avoid clumping; one mouse sample fills 192 wells, two samples can fill a single plate by splitting halves, or pool multiple samples if yield is low. Apply the following gating sequence: (1) Hoechst (blue) vs back‑scatter to select nuclei; (2) NucFix Red (red) to exclude non‑viable cells; (3) forward‑scatter vs back‑scatter to remove debris and large clumps; (4) forward‑scatter area vs height to eliminate doublets. After sorting, immediately seal plates with foil, centrifuge at 1000 g for 1 min at 4 °C, keep plates briefly on dry ice, then transfer to a –80 °C freezer for long‑term storage. Proceed to SmartSeq3 cDNA library preparation.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate sorter to finish dispensing within 30 min after filtration.
Pre‑dispense lysis buffer into 384‑well plates (SmartSeq3).
Set sorter to single‑cell mode, 100 µm nozzle, keep everything at 4 °C.
Sort cells within 30 min; 1 sample → 192 wells, 2 samples → split plate, pool if needed.
Gate: Hoechst vs back‑scatter; NucFix Red vs fluorescence; forward vs back‑scatter; FSC‑area vs FSC‑height.
Seal plates with foil, centrifuge 1000 g for 1 min at 4 °C.
Place on dry ice briefly, then store at –80 °C.
Begin SmartSeq3 library preparation.

description: The protocol below describes specific steps for microdissecting tissue punchouts of the preBötC but could be adapted for other brainstem regions by cutting tissue slices from different locations along the rostrocaudal extent of the brainstem and targeting other regions of interest when taking punchouts.
